title: Fleet audit decisions
description: The four analyses recorded as data. One object per recommendation. A recommendation that cannot be written as one of these objects is not yet a finding.

name.description: The pair, the suite, the merged product, or the new product.

rank.description: Position in the value / effort ordering. 1 is done first.

components.description: Suites, merges and products: the repositories that supply a part.

parts.description: New products: component name to the repository that already supplies it.

what.description: The specific thing that moves, named at the level of a function, format or algorithm. Never 'the crypto'.

spine.description: Suites: the shared model in one sentence, and which repository owns it or that it must be created.

why.description: Why it matters to a user, not to a maintainer.

risk.description: The one real risk, not a list.

do_nothing.description: True for the explicit do-nothing list. Naming what not to touch is part of the answer.
